AP cells show dimension points before weighting, with a color scale centered at zero.

Figure 12:Complete P121 frames at 6.0 seconds. Orange dashed boxes highlight the second mode, and circles mark the tracked material point: it follows the curve in Astra’s frame but separates from it in Kimi’s. Temporal evidence establishes the underlying rate mismatch.
